::: {#def-set-builder-expression}
#### Set-builder notation with an expression

For a set $A$ and an expression $f(x)$ that has a value for each element $x$ of $A$,
the notation $\set{f(x) : x \in A}$
denotes the set of the values $f(x)$ for $x \in A$
[@wikipedia_set_builder_notation].
That is, an object $y$ is an element of $\set{f(x) : x \in A}$
when $y = f(x)$ for some $x \in A$.

:::
